details: HCF is the largest positive integer that divides two or more given numbers without leaving a remainder.
Used when partitioning or dividing quantities into the maximum possible equal sized units without waste.
evidence_or_examples: Maximum square tile size for a 12 ft × 16 ft floor: HCF(12, 16) = 4 ft (requires 12 tiles of 4x4)
Relief packing of 225 kg rice and 750 kg wheat into maximum equal bags: HCF(225, 750) = 75 kg (13 bags total)

details: LCM is the smallest non-zero common multiple of two or more given numbers.
Used when calculating repeating cycles, simultaneous events, or common meeting lengths.
Co-prime Numbers: Two numbers with HCF = 1.
evidence_or_examples: Shortest common toran cloth strip length for 6 cm and 8 cm strips: LCM(6, 8) = 24 cm
3 bells tolling at 9, 12, 15 min intervals meeting after LCM(9,12,15) = 180 min (3 hours)

sub_branches.concept: Prime Factorisation Method & HCF-LCM Product Formula
details: Express numbers as products of prime factors with exponents.
HCF = Product of common prime factors with lowest powers.
LCM = Product of all prime factors with highest powers.
Two-Number Formula: HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b.
